versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Options Wheel Strategy Screener.
- Screens watchlists for cash-secured put opportunities using yfinance (no API key required).
- Finds options nearest a target days-to-expiration (DTE) and out-of-the-money percentage (OTM%).
- Estimates premium yield (period and annualized), implied volatility, volume, and open interest.
- Command-line tool for watchlist scanning and comparison of wheel candidates.
- For idea generation only; does not place trades or connect to a broker.
